notes.title: Solo Tactics is Joining Steam Next Fest! 🎉
notes.content:
⚔️ Solo Tactics is Coming to Steam Next Fest! 🎉
We’re thrilled to announce that Solo Tactics will be part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest!

From October 13th – October 20th, 2025 (PDT), you’ll be able to:


✅ Play our free demo
✅ Test out fast-paced 1v1 tactical battles
✅ Swap between 3 champions mid-fight to outthink your opponent
✅ Share your feedback and help shape the future of the game

This is a huge milestone for us as a small indie team, and we can’t wait for you to get hands-on with Solo Tactics.

👉 Don’t forget to Wishlist & Follow the game to stay updated:


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3233940/Solo_Tactics/"][/dynamiclink]

Thank you all for the amazing support — see you in the arena! 💚
